summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd, a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release about operational updates at its Kruh Block. The release announces the commencement of operations at the K-29 well and plans for the WK-5 wellsite as part of an ongoing drilling program. No special situation is present; the filing is a standard update on drilling progress and regulatory approvals. It does not involve mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or other corporate events. The filing is not a special situation.
